capabilities.name: Check SKYFALL status
capabilities.description: Returns the local SKYFALL application and capability status. It does not inspect user files or connect to cloud services.
limitations: Reports local application capability state only.
Does not authenticate to Azure or Power Platform.
Does not inspect or execute local scripts.

capabilities.name: Browse available capabilities
capabilities.description: Lists capabilities explicitly registered and enabled in the SKYFALL capability catalogue.
limitations: Lists implemented capabilities only.
Planned integrations are not represented as executable tools.

capabilities.name: Explain a capability
capabilities.description: Returns the registered description, inputs, risk level and limitations for one SKYFALL capability ID.

capability_id.description: Exact capability ID, for example core.get_status.

limitations: Only returns entries from the local capability catalogue.
Does not activate or install capabilities.

capabilities.name: Check workspace indexing
capabilities.description: Returns aggregate index status only for enabled workspaces whose metadata sharing was explicitly approved in the SKYFALL desktop UI.
limitations: Reports aggregate metadata only.
Does not inspect folders or trigger a scan.
Does not return source code.

capabilities.name: Browse approved workspaces
capabilities.description: Lists only enabled workspace roots for which the user explicitly allowed filenames and extracted metadata to be shared with Copilot.
limitations: Workspaces without AI metadata consent are omitted.
Does not return source code or secrets.

capabilities.name: Find scripts and files
capabilities.description: Searches indexed filenames and locally extracted static metadata in enabled workspaces with explicit AI metadata-sharing consent.

query.description: Search words or script name, 1 to 200 characters.

file_type.description: all, scripts, documents, powershell, python, yaml, json, or markdown.

limitations: Search results contain metadata only.
Source file contents are not returned.
Sensitive-looking files and detected secret-bearing files are excluded.

capabilities.name: Inspect script or file metadata
capabilities.description: Returns extracted static metadata for one indexed file in an AI-approved workspace, including parameters, functions, imports and summary where detected.
limitations: Returns metadata only, not source code.
Only works for enabled workspaces with explicit AI metadata consent.
Static analysis is best-effort and does not execute code.

capabilities.name: Browse Azure accounts
capabilities.description: Lists the SKYFALL Azure CLI profile names and non-secret metadata, including isolated account profiles.
limitations: Returns profile metadata only, not tokens or credential-cache contents.
A profile must be created and authenticated by the user before it can be queried.

capabilities.name: Check Azure connection
capabilities.description: Checks whether a specified Azure CLI profile is authenticated and returns non-secret account, tenant and current subscription metadata.

profile_id.description: Azure profile ID returned by list_azure_profiles, or all for all registered profiles.

limitations: Does not sign in, sign out or switch accounts.
Reports the currently cached account context for the selected Azure CLI profile.

capabilities.name: View Azure subscriptions
capabilities.description: Lists subscriptions in one or all registered Azure CLI profiles. Can optionally refresh the local subscription cache from Azure.

profile_id.description: Azure profile ID returned by list_azure_profiles, or all for all registered profiles.

refresh.description: Whether to refresh subscriptions from Azure rather than use the current CLI cache.

limitations: Scope is limited to subscriptions exposed by the selected Azure CLI profile.
Does not create, update, delete or change the active subscription.

capabilities.name: View Azure tenants
capabilities.description: Lists distinct tenant IDs represented in one or all registered Azure CLI profiles subscription cache.

profile_id.description: Azure profile ID returned by list_azure_profiles, or all for all registered profiles.

refresh.description: Whether to refresh the subscription cache first.

limitations: Tenant discovery is derived from the selected profile account and subscription cache.
It is not a directory-wide enumeration of every tenant in which the user may be a guest.

capabilities.name: Browse Power Platform accounts
capabilities.description: Lists existing PAC CLI authentication profiles and identifies the active profile without switching profiles.
limitations: PAC CLI output is a human-readable table and parsing is best-effort.
Does not create, delete, rename or select a PAC CLI profile.

capabilities.name: Check Power Platform connection
capabilities.description: Reports the currently active PAC CLI authentication profile and whether one is available.
limitations: Reports the currently active PAC CLI profile only.
Does not switch to another profile or return access tokens.

capabilities.name: View Power Platform environments
capabilities.description: Uses pac admin list --json to discover environments visible to the currently active PAC CLI profile.
limitations: Uses the currently active PAC CLI profile only.
Tenant-wide discovery may require Power Platform administrative permissions.
Does not switch profiles or modify environments.

capabilities.name: Connect an Azure account
capabilities.description: Starts an explicit user-requested Microsoft browser sign-in for a named isolated Azure CLI profile. A new profile requires a profile name and tenant GUID/domain; an existing profile can be addressed by profile ID. After sign-in, subscription and tenant discovery runs automatically.

profile_name.description: Required for a new isolated profile; profile display name.

tenant_id.description: Required for a new profile, or to configure an existing profile; tenant GUID or verified domain.

profile_id.description: Optional existing SKYFALL Azure profile ID. If omitted, a new profile is created.

limitations: Call only when the user explicitly asks to sign in, connect, or add an Azure account.
Browser sign-in is isolated in the selected profile AZURE_CONFIG_DIR; the default Azure CLI context is not changed.
Does not create, update or delete Azure resources.
The job runs asynchronously; use get_microsoft_auth_job_status after the user completes sign-in.

capabilities.name: Connect a Power Platform account
capabilities.description: After explicit user acknowledgement that PAC CLI profile creation may change the globally active profile for the local PAC CLI installation, creates a named profile and starts interactive Microsoft sign-in. The delegated tenant is resolved from the Microsoft account chosen in the browser.

profile_name.description: Required profile display name, 1 to 30 characters.

environment.description: Optional environment name, URL or ID.

confirm_global_profile_activation.description: Must be true only after the user explicitly confirms the warning that this PAC profile may become globally active for the local PAC CLI installation.

limitations: Call only when the user explicitly asks to sign in, connect, or add a Power Platform account.
Before calling with confirmation=true, explain the possible global active-profile side effect and obtain a clear yes from the user.
PAC CLI delegated sign-in derives the tenant from the signed-in user; the standard user flow does not accept a tenant argument.
Does not create, update or delete Power Platform resources.
The job runs asynchronously; use get_microsoft_auth_job_status after sign-in.

capabilities.name: Check sign-in progress
capabilities.description: Returns the status of a SKYFALL-started Azure or Power Platform sign-in job and safe account, tenant, subscription or environment metadata when discovery completes.

job_id.description: Job ID returned by start_azure_login or start_powerplatform_login.

limitations: Only jobs created in the current local MCP server process are available.
Never returns access tokens, refresh tokens or credential-cache content.

capabilities.name: Discover Azure Function Apps
capabilities.description: Discover Azure Function Apps across accessible subscriptions and create a detailed Excel report with a clear scope-based filename.

profile_id.description: Azure profile ID from list_azure_profiles, or 'all' for every registered authenticated profile.

subscription_ids.description: Optional subscription ID allow-filter. Every ID must already be accessible in the selected profile(s).

generate_excel.description: Generate a detailed local XLSX report in reports/Azure.

limitations: Queries only enabled subscriptions visible to the selected authenticated Azure CLI profile(s).
Azure Resource Graph indexing may lag recent resource changes.
Resource Graph permissions are required; a profile may be authenticated but lack Reader/Resource Graph access.
App settings, connection strings, publishing profiles, host keys and function keys are never retrieved.
The operation does not create, update or delete Azure resources. XLSX output is a local file write.

capabilities.name: Generate Power Automate flow inventory
capabilities.description: Discover cloud-flow metadata in one explicitly selected Power Platform environment and create a formatted Excel report. Uses the active PAC CLI profile and the signed-in user permissions.

environment_id.description: Required environment GUID from the discovered Power Platform environment list.

environment_name.description: Human-readable environment name used in the report title and filename.

generate_excel.description: Generate a detailed local Excel workbook under reports/PowerPlatform.

limitations: Uses the currently active PAC CLI profile only; SKYFALL does not silently switch PAC CLI profiles.
Results include cloud flows visible to the signed-in user in the selected environment; environment permissions determine coverage.
The PAC CLI list-cloud-flows command is documented by Microsoft as Preview.
Flow definitions, action payloads, connection details, credentials and secrets are not read or exported.
The operation does not create, update or delete cloud resources; it writes only a local report.
